scope: Source and completed C117 metadata/artifact boundary review only. No C119 interim game rows, outcomes, new games, changed modes or tuning.

contract.host_rng: random.Random(master tournament seed); separate sequential draws, not cryptographic independence.
contract.private_dos_draws: Each pair draws getrandbits(32) for A then B before separately drawing move_seed in [1,59999]. Private seeds are not derived from move_seed and are not sent to the honest policy.
contract.used_dos_army: Policy-owned mode replaces unused A with the honest policy army; B remains the opponent. Both private draws are retained for reproducibility.
contract.own_setup_protocol: Separate frozen-policy process receives new red, Classic rules, difficulty, own setup seed, setup, quit. It receives no enemy formation, private setup seed or tournament master seed.
contract.orientation: Normal mixture reflects the whole own formation exactly when its existing rejection-sampled setup ticket is >=5; no new draw or opponent input.
contract.movement: Python and OpenMP initialize each participant with seed move_seed*2+army+1, new side and actual own army. Explicit opponent-setup is sent only to original DOS or labelled diagnostic policies under receives_opponent_setup.
contract.audit_records: Stored metadata includes both own and enemy setups and private seeds for reproducibility. Stored audit knowledge is not a live input to the honest policy.

interpretation: The mixture orientation depends deterministically on own setup seed, which is linked to the same move_seed used to initialize movement. Its selected orientation and movement stream therefore are coupled by the benchmark contract. This is honest own randomness, not evidence of hidden-rank leakage. Separate pseudorandom private enemy draws do not establish a mathematical or cryptographic independence guarantee.
limitations: A nominal five-of-ten setup ticket rule does not guarantee exactly 50/50 orientation on a fixed finite cohort or under every seed mapping.
Results do not establish robustness to another deployment/movement RNG coupling, a changed seed distribution, or complete production play.
This source/receipt review is not a new causal decomposition, runtime security proof, strength test, or hardware suitability result.
